p: Jacob saw that there was corn: This story shows plainly that all things are governed by God's providence for the profit of his Church.
look one upon another: As men destitute of counsel.
made himself strange unto them: This concealing is not to be followed, nor any actions of the father's not approved by God's word.

By the life of Pharaoh ye: The Egyptians who were idolaters, used to swear by their king's life: but God forbids swearing by anyone but him: yet Joseph dwelling among the wicked was corrupted by them.
fear God: And therefore am true and just.
We are verily guilty concerning our: Affliction makes men acknowledge their faults, which otherwise they would conceal.
blood is required: God will take vengeance on us, and measure us with our own measure.
wept: Though he acts harshly, yet his brotherly affection remained.
afraid: Because their conscience accused them of their sin, they thought God had brought them trouble through the money.
me: For they did not seem to be concerned or have any love for their brother which increased his sorrow: and partly as it appears he suspected them for Joseph.
